# Sri Sai Durga Astrology Centre

> Vedic astrology and Vastu consultation in Hyderabad, India. Pandit Sri Santosh Sharma Ji, 35+ years of practice, in person at Sanjeeva Reddy Nagar or online. Rated 5.0 on Google (1,647 reviews). Open 24 hours. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 81257 03372.

Business details (match the Google Business Profile): Sri Sai Durga Astrology Centre, House No. 247/3RT, Flat No. 502, 5th Floor, Ramakrishna Nivas, beside Andhra Bank, opposite Royal College, Bapu Nagar, Sanjeeva Reddy Nagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500038. Consultations are by call or WhatsApp booking only. Fees are shared before booking and are not published on the site. No guaranteed outcomes are promised.
